verdict.rationale: 2FAS's first-party support docs list imports from Aegis, Raivo, LastPass, Stratum (Authenticator Pro) and Google Authenticator. That directly covers migrating tokens from other authenticator apps instead of re-enrolling each account. However, the evidence is a single support-page sentence with no detail on the import mechanics. Missing for 10: documentation of how the bulk import works (file formats, QR migration, encrypted-backup handling), coverage of other popular apps beyond the five listed, and independent or hands-on corroboration that imports work as claimed.
